root: ^I just couldn't do it. I'm taking her to Klaus and the Medical Center. At least she'll be in a clean environment.
^My research will be squashed. It was always way too experimental for popular science. But how can we make progress in the medical field if we don't make any sacrifices?

^I should've done more operative and surgical work. At least then I would've handled the sight of human insides better. Maybe they'll let me work in the operating room if I put my own work on pause and archive it for later use.
^I will be known for my work, be it for curing my daughter or somebody else. I'm working on something groundbreaking here. They just don't see it yet.
